items.title: 衛浴巨頭搶吃AI大餅 TOTO砸300億日元進軍半導體陶瓷
items.title_en: Bathroom Giant Seizes AI Pie, TOTO Invests ¥30 Billion to Enter Semiconductor Ceramics
paras: 以馬桶、衛浴設備聞名的日本 TOTO 正加速搶進 AI 半導體供應鏈。隨著 AI GPU、HBM 及先進晶片需求成長，TOTO 計劃投入 300 億日元擴大半導體先進陶瓷布局，其中 170 億日元將用於興建陶瓷研發大樓，將數十年累積的陶瓷技術轉化為新成長動能。
TOTO 布局精密陶瓷並非近期才開始。公司早在 1976 年便啟動相關研究，1984 年正式投入陶瓷業務，並在中長期策略「WILL2030」中，將半導體先進陶瓷定位為核心成長領域，業務觸角也從傳統衛浴陶瓷逐步延伸至半導體及光通訊市場。
目前 TOTO 的半導體陶瓷產品主要包括靜電卡盤（ESC）與 AD 氣溶膠沉積陶瓷零件。靜電卡盤利用靜電力固定晶圓，由於先進製程對溫度、平整度及顆粒控制要求嚴格，因此成為晶片製造設備的重要零件。
另一項 AD 氣溶膠沉積技術，則是以接近音速噴射陶瓷粉末，形成緻密的氧化釔陶瓷膜，具備抗等離子腐蝕能力，可降低晶片生產過程中的顆粒污染，性能優於傳統熱噴塗製程。
隨著 AI GPU、HBM 與先進晶片需求爆發，也持續推升這兩類產品需求。
研發、量產同步擴張
為掌握半導體需求，TOTO 採取研發與製造同步擴張策略。研發方面，茅崎基地負責技術開發，新建大樓將主攻下一代靜電卡盤及 AD 零件技術；量產則由中津工廠及豐前工廠負責。
其中，豐前工廠的靜電卡盤燒成廠房已於 2025 年 12 月開工，預計 2027 年 1 月投產，中津工廠也已完成多輪擴建。透過「茅崎研發、中津與豐前製造」的分工模式，TOTO 逐步建立從材料開發、設計、生產到性能驗證的完整體系。
AI 需求一路傳導至上游陶瓷
AI 算力擴張帶來的需求已不只集中在 GPU 與 HBM，也進一步傳導至半導體設備與材料。過去相對小眾的靜電卡盤、氧化釔塗層等零件，在晶片製造的高溫及強等離子環境下扮演重要角色，高性能特種陶瓷更直接影響製程良率。
TOTO 正將長年在衛浴陶瓷領域累積的材料與燒結工藝轉移至半導體材料，且本輪投資並非終點，公司後續還規劃更大規模擴產。隨著 AI 半導體需求向上游延伸，傳統陶瓷業者也正逐步深入半導體供應鏈。
paras_en: Japanese bathroom fixture leader TOTO, known for toilets and bathroom equipment, is accelerating its entry into the AI semiconductor supply chain. With growing demand for AI GPUs, HBM and advanced chips, TOTO plans to invest ¥30 billion to expand its advanced semiconductor ceramic portfolio, of which ¥17 billion will fund a new ceramic R&D building to turn decades of ceramic expertise into a new growth engine.

TOTO’s push into precision ceramics is not new. The company began related research in 1976, formally entered the ceramic business in 1984, and under its mid‑to‑long‑term “WILL2030” strategy positions advanced semiconductor ceramics as a core growth area, gradually extending its reach from traditional bathroom ceramics to semiconductor and optical‑communication markets.

Today TOTO’s semiconductor‑ceramic products mainly include electrostatic chucks (ESC) and AD aerosol‑deposited ceramic components. The ESC uses electrostatic force to hold wafers; because advanced processes demand strict control of temperature, flatness and particle contamination, ESCs have become critical parts of chip‑manufacturing equipment.

Another AD aerosol‑deposition technology sprays ceramic powder at near‑sonic speed to form a dense yttrium‑oxide ceramic film that resists plasma corrosion, reducing particle contamination during wafer production and outperforming conventional thermal spray processes.
The explosion in demand for AI GPUs, HBM and advanced chips continues to drive up demand for these two product categories.
R&D and mass production expanding in tandem

To capture semiconductor demand, TOTO is expanding R&D and manufacturing simultaneously. R&D is handled at its Machida base, where the new building will focus on next‑generation ESCs and AD components; mass production is carried out at the Nakatsu and Toyohashi plants.

The Toyohashi plant’s ESC sintering facility broke ground in December 2025 and is slated to start operation in January 2027, while the Nakatsu plant has completed multiple expansion phases. Through a division of labor among Machida R&D, Nakatsu and Toyohashi manufacturing, TOTO is building a complete system from material development and design to production and performance verification.
AI demand cascades upstream to ceramics

The expansion of AI compute power creates demand not only for GPUs and HBM but also for semiconductor equipment and materials. Previously niche components such as ESCs and yttrium‑oxide coatings now play vital roles in the high‑temperature, high‑plasma environments of chip fabrication, where high‑performance specialty ceramics directly affect process yield.

TOTO is transferring the material and sintering know‑how accumulated over years in bathroom ceramics to semiconductor materials, and this round of investment is not the end; the company plans even larger scale expansion. As AI semiconductor demand pushes further upstream, traditional ceramic makers are steadily deepening their involvement in the semiconductor supply chain.

items.title: 攸泰Q3營運動能回升 衛星應用增溫持續深化北美布局
items.title_en: Yototech Q3 Revenue Expected to Recover as Satellite Application Heats Up and North America Expansion Deepens
paras: 工業電腦廠攸泰科技 (6928-TW) 上半年受受到客戶專案出貨時程及營收規模影響，每股虧損 0.34 元；不過，隨著衛星應用增溫、北美布局持續深化，第三季營運動能逐步回升。
攸泰上半年營收 9.42 億元，年減 18%；毛利率 28%，較去年同期改善；營業損失 5,118 萬元，稅後淨損 2,942 萬元；不過，7 月營收 1.82 億元，月增 28%、年增 18%；前 7 月營收約 11.24 億元，年減 14%，年減幅度較上半年收斂。
攸泰表示，衛星應用成為 7 月主要成長動能之一，單月營收年增 415%、月增 247%，營收占比提升至近 2 成，主要受政府方案相關專案及衛星通訊產品出貨增加帶動；累計前 7 月衛星應用營收年增 6%，占整體營收比重由去年同期個位數提升至 1 成，顯示相關專案逐步轉化為營收貢獻。
既有核心海事業務 7 月出貨亦較前月回升，單月營收月增 65%；惟受客戶專案時程及去年同期基期較高影響，仍年減 21%。累計前 7 月海事業務營收占比逾五成，仍為公司最大應用市場，公司持續掌握主要客戶專案進度及後續出貨時程，深化既有市場布局。
區域市場方面，主要市場出貨動能回升，其中美洲市場營收月增 30%、年增 7%；歐洲市場月增 68%、年增 93%；亞洲市場亦年增 52%。營收比重來看，美洲營收占比逾四成；歐洲占三成。
累計前 7 月美洲市場營收年增 7%，占整體營收比重由去年同期約三成提升至近四成；亞洲市場年增 43%，營收占比穩健提升；歐洲市場雖受前期專案出貨時程影響年減 26%，但 7 月單月已明顯回升。
新事業布局方面，隨美國子公司營運整合及業務拓展逐步推進，攸泰持續強化北美在地營運與服務能力，並透過集團資源整合擴大產品及應用布局，深化北美市場發展基礎。
攸泰表示，持續聚焦海事、衛星通訊、智慧強固型行動裝置及其他關鍵任務應用市場。隨美國子公司整合持續推進、併購綜效逐步發酵，加上新應用市場拓展及衛星相關專案陸續推進，後續將持續掌握各市場專案進度與出貨動能，同時優化產品組合及營運效率，強化中長期成長動能。
paras_en: Yototech (6928-TW), a leading industrial computer manufacturer, reported a net loss of NT$0.34 per share for the first half of the year due to delayed customer project shipments and revenue scale. However, with the satellite application heating up and North America expansion deepening, the company's third-quarter revenue is expected to recover gradually.

Yototech's first-half revenue reached NT$9.42 billion, a year-on-year decline of 18%. Gross margin improved to 28% compared to the same period last year. The company reported an operating loss of NT$51.18 million and a net loss of NT$29.42 million. However, July revenue reached NT$1.82 billion, a 28% month-on-month increase and an 18% year-on-year increase. The company's revenue for the first seven months of the year was approximately NT$11.24 billion, a year-on-year decline of 14%, with a narrowing year-on-year decline rate compared to the first half.

Yototech stated that satellite applications became a major growth driver in July, with a 415% year-on-year increase and a 247% month-on-month increase in revenue. The revenue share rose to nearly 20%, mainly driven by government project-related projects and satellite communication product shipments. Cumulatively, the company's satellite application revenue grew 6% year-on-year, accounting for 10% of the company's total revenue, up from a single-digit percentage last year, indicating that related projects are gradually converting into revenue contributions.

Both the core marine business and the July shipments also rebounded, with a 65% month-on-month increase in revenue. However, the revenue still declined 21% year-on-year due to customer project timelines and a higher base period last year. Cumulatively, the marine business revenue accounted for over 50% of the company's total revenue, remaining the company's largest application market. The company continues to grasp the progress of major customer projects and subsequent shipment schedules, deepening its existing market layout.

In terms of regional markets, the main market shipment momentum has recovered, with the Americas market revenue increasing 30% month-on-month and 7% year-on-year. The European market revenue increased 68% month-on-month and 93% year-on-year. The Asian market also increased 52% year-on-year. In terms of revenue share, the Americas market accounted for over 40%, while the European market accounted for 30%.

Cumulatively, the Americas market revenue increased 7% year-on-year, accounting for nearly 40% of the company's total revenue, up from around 30% last year. The Asian market revenue increased 43%, with a stable increase in revenue share. The European market, although affected by the delayed project shipment schedule, showed a significant rebound in July.

In terms of new business layout, with the operation integration and business expansion of the US subsidiary gradually advancing, Yototech continues to strengthen its local operations and service capabilities in North America. Through the integration of group resources, the company has expanded its product and application layout, deepening the foundation for North America market development.

Yototech stated that it will continue to focus on the marine, satellite communication, intelligent rugged mobile devices, and other key mission application markets. With the continued advancement of US subsidiary integration, the gradual fermentation of merger synergies, and the expansion of new application markets, as well as the continuous progress of satellite-related projects, the company will continue to grasp the progress of various market projects and shipment momentum, while optimizing product combinations and operational efficiency to strengthen long-term growth momentum.

items.title: 三星HBM4良率飆破80%黃金線 明年市占可望超車SK海力士
items.title_en: Samsung HBM4 Yield Breaks 80% Threshold, Poised to Surpass SK Hynix in Market Share Next Year
paras: 全球高頻寬記憶體（HBM）龍頭之爭升溫。SK 海力士 (000660KS) 正因獎金與薪酬方案陷入勞資僵局，HBM4 擴產恐面臨變數；三星電子 (005930KS) 則加速追趕，HBM4 良率已突破 80%「黃金良率」。瑞銀預估，三星 2027 年 HBM 位元出貨市占率可望升至 41%，微幅超越 SK 海力士的 39%，全球 HBM 市場龍頭寶座可能易主。
SK 海力士與工會於 8 月 9 日完成第五輪談判，但雙方仍未能就獎金方案達成共識，爭議核心集中在「利潤分享獎金」的發放方式。
SK 海力士原先的利潤分享機制，是提撥半導體事業部年度營業利益的 10% 成立員工獎金池，其中員工核算所得獎金的 80% 於當年發放，其餘 20% 分兩年以現金支付，機制原定有效期為 10 年。
去年勞資雙方進一步約定，獎金全數以現金發放，但資方今年提出新方案，希望將超過半數的利潤分享獎金改以公司股票支付，並設置閉鎖期，導致談判陷入停滯。工會尤其不滿資方僅隔一年，就希望修改歷經 11 輪談判才敲定的獎金協議。
資方提出股票支付方案，主要希望降低獎金快速增加帶來的大額現金流出壓力，在員工獎金、資本支出與股東回報之間取得平衡，並認為股票獎酬有助於將員工利益與公司長期價值綁定。
工會則反對相關安排，認為此舉等同把股價下跌造成的損失風險，以及資本利得稅負擔轉嫁給員工。除了獎金爭議，資方提出在虧損期間彈性調整薪資的方案也沒有進展，工會認為該制度本質上就是降薪工具。
勞資對峙恐牽動 HBM4 擴產
勞方不滿已從談判桌延燒至公司內部。一個涵蓋生產與技術辦公職位的 SK 海力士工會籌備小組，自 8 月 5 日成立後，短短三天參與人數便突破 3,500 人，相當於公司約 10% 的員工，並已於 8 月 8 日提出工會組建申請。
有分析師指出，若勞資爭議遲遲無法解決，可能成為 SK 海力士第六代 HBM 產品 HBM4 擴產的一項變數。
SK 海力士原計畫第二季啟動 HBM4 批量出貨，並於下半年正式大規模擴產；一旦集體行動進一步蔓延至生產線，供貨節奏可能面臨壓力。
就在 SK 海力士面臨勞資問題之際，三星電子 HBM4 量產進度正在加速，讓兩家南韓記憶體大廠的競爭進一步從技術研發延伸至產能與市場份額之爭。
三星 HBM4 達 80%「黃金良率」
韓國媒體報導稱，三星電子 HBM4 近期良率已達 80%。在半導體產業中，80% 良率被稱為「黃金良率」，意味產品缺陷率已達可控水準、產出趨於穩定，並具備獲利基礎。
值得注意的是，三星 HBM4 今年 2 月剛開始量產時，良率還不到 60%，但僅花約六個月便提升至 80%。
業內人士指出，三星原先設定的年底良率目標就是 80%，但隨著下半年量產規模擴大，製程改善速度超出預期，也使 HBM 市場競爭逐漸由技術研發轉向產能爭奪。
三星記憶體業務高級副總裁 Kim Jae-joon 日前在第二季財報電話會議表示，第三季 HBM4 營收將較前一季成長兩倍以上，下半年 HBM4 營收占整體 HBM 營收比重將輕鬆超過 60%。
三星目前已設定目標，力拚年底將 HBM 市場占有率提升至約 38%。這一數字與三星目前在傳統 DRAM 市場的市占率相當，意味三星希望讓 HBM 業務逐步向其 DRAM 市場地位靠攏。
2027 年三星市占率可望反超
不過，SK 海力士在 HBM4 競爭中仍具備強勁防守能力。公司 HBM 銷售及行銷副總裁 Kim Ki-tae 指出，只有具備穩定良率、品質及大規模供貨能力，才算擁有完整的 HBM4 競爭力，目前 SK 海力士 HBM4 的量產良率與品質水準，正逐漸接近已成熟的上一代 HBM3E。
業界研判，SK 海力士 HBM4 良率同樣已進入 80% 區間，因此三星雖然快速追趕，但雙方真正的勝負關鍵仍將落在後續量產及供貨能力。
瑞銀近期報告預估，若以 HBM 位元出貨量計算，2026 年 SK 海力士仍將以 48% 的市占率穩居第一；但到了 2027 年，三星市占率可望升至 41%，微幅超越 SK 海力士的 39%。
HBM 位元出貨量主要統計 HBM 晶片全部記憶體位元總容量，可用來衡量實際供給規模。市場普遍認為，三星與 SK 海力士的 HBM 競爭，最終可能在明年量產的 HBM4E 市場分出高下。
三星的優勢在於擴產潛力，SK 海力士則具備量產品質優勢，兩家公司第四季的供貨擴張速度，可能成為左右未來 HBM 市場版圖的重要關鍵。
paras_en: The global high-bandwidth memory (HBM) market is heating up, with SK Hynix (000660KS) facing labor disputes over bonus and salary schemes, potentially impacting its HBM4 production expansion. In contrast, Samsung Electronics (005930KS) is accelerating its pursuit, with its HBM4 yield already breaking the 80% "golden yield" threshold.

SK Hynix and the union completed their fifth round of negotiations on August 9, but failed to reach a consensus on the bonus scheme, with the core issue being the method of distributing "profit-sharing bonuses".

SK Hynix's original profit-sharing mechanism involved setting aside 10% of the semiconductor business's annual operating profit to create an employee bonus pool, with employees accounting for 80% of their bonus in the same year and the remaining 20% paid in cash over two years. The mechanism was originally set to expire in 10 years.

Last year, the labor and management sides further agreed to pay the bonus in full in cash, but the management side proposed a new scheme this year, hoping to pay more than half of the profit-sharing bonus in company stock and setting up a lock-up period, leading to a stalemate in negotiations. The union was particularly unhappy that the management side wanted to modify the bonus agreement, which had been negotiated over 11 rounds of talks.

The management side proposed the stock payment scheme to reduce the pressure of large cash outflows caused by rapid increases in employee bonuses, and to achieve a balance between employee bonuses, capital expenditures, and shareholder returns. They believe that stock-based compensation can help tie employee interests to the company's long-term value.

The union, however, opposed the arrangement, arguing that it would shift the risk of stock price declines and capital gains tax burdens to employees. In addition to the bonus dispute, the management side's proposal to adjust salaries flexibly during periods of loss also made no progress, with the union viewing the system as a de facto salary cut.
The labor dispute may impact HBM4 production expansion.

The labor dispute has spread from the negotiating table to within the company. A SK Hynix union preparatory committee, established on August 5, has seen its membership surge to over 3,500 in just three days, equivalent to around 10% of the company's employees, and has submitted an application to establish a union on August 8.
Analysts point out that if the labor dispute is not resolved, it may become a variable in SK Hynix's sixth-generation HBM product, HBM4, production expansion.

SK Hynix originally planned to start mass-producing HBM4 in the second quarter and expand production in the second half of the year. If the labor dispute spreads to the production line, the supply chain may face pressure.

As SK Hynix faces labor issues, Samsung Electronics is accelerating its HBM4 production, further intensifying the competition between the two South Korean memory giants from technology research and development to production capacity and market share.
Samsung's HBM4 has reached an 80% "golden yield".

According to reports, Samsung's HBM4 yield has recently reached 80%. In the semiconductor industry, an 80% yield is considered the "golden yield," indicating that the product's defect rate has reached a controllable level, production is becoming stable, and profitability is achievable.
Notably, Samsung's HBM4 yield was below 60% when it started mass production in February, but it has risen to 80% in just six months.

Industry insiders point out that Samsung's original year-end yield target was 80%, but with the production scale expanding in the second half of the year, the process improvement speed exceeded expectations, and the HBM market competition has gradually shifted from technology research and development to production capacity.

Samsung's memory business senior vice president, Kim Jae-joon, said in a second-quarter earnings call that HBM4 revenue in the third quarter will grow more than twice that of the previous quarter, and HBM4 revenue will account for more than 60% of total HBM revenue in the second half of the year.

Samsung has set a target to increase its HBM market share to around 38% by the end of the year, a number similar to its current market share in the traditional DRAM market, indicating that Samsung hopes to gradually bring its HBM business closer to its DRAM market position.
Samsung's market share may surpass SK Hynix in 2027.

However, SK Hynix still has strong defensive capabilities in the HBM4 competition. SK Hynix's HBM sales and marketing vice president, Kim Ki-tae, said that only companies with stable yields, quality, and large-scale supply capabilities can be considered to have complete HBM4 competitiveness. Currently, SK Hynix's HBM4 production yield and quality are gradually approaching those of the mature HBM3E.

Industry analysts believe that SK Hynix's HBM4 yield has also entered the 80% range, so Samsung's rapid pursuit may not be the decisive factor. The true outcome will depend on subsequent production and supply capacity.

A recent report by Credit Suisse estimates that if HBM bit shipments are used as the metric, SK Hynix will still maintain a 48% market share in 2026, but Samsung's market share may rise to 41% in 2027, narrowly surpassing SK Hynix's 39%.

HBM bit shipments mainly include the total memory bits of all HBM chips, which can be used to measure the actual supply scale. The market generally believes that the competition between Samsung and SK Hynix in the HBM market may ultimately be decided in the HBM4E market, which will be produced in mass quantities next year.

Samsung's advantage lies in its production capacity expansion potential, while SK Hynix has a quality advantage in production. The two companies' fourth-quarter supply expansion speed may become a crucial factor in determining the future HBM market landscape.

items.title: 智元超宇樹居冠！今年H1全球人形機器人出貨1.91萬台 陸廠97%市佔 美廠連車尾燈都看不到
items.title_en: Agibot Surpasses UBTech to Top Global Service Robot Shipments in H1 2023
paras: 根據市場研究機構 Smart Analytics Global(SAG) 最新報告，今年上半年全球人型機器人出貨約 1.91 萬台，較去年同期 5100 台暴增近 300%，其中中國廠商拿下超過 97% 市佔率，延續並擴大 2025 年 84.7% 的領先優勢。
數據顯示，上海智元機器人 (Agibot) 今年上半年出貨 8400 台、佔全球 44%，首度超越宇樹科技登上第一，宇樹以 5900 台、30.9% 市佔率居次，兩家合計吃下逾七成市場，特斯拉、Figure AI、Agility Robotics 等美系業者出貨量仍明顯落後。
SAG 創辦人 Linda Sui 提到，工業與商業用途佔今年上半年出貨逾 70%，高於一年前約 50%，顯示產品正從展示研發走向實際部署。
SAG 還預估，今年全球人形機器人出貨量將衝上 6 萬台，2030 年破 50 萬台。
在今年上海 WAIC 大會上，數十家中國企業秀出靈巧度與移動速度進展，印證政策與資金加持下的量產能力。
但與此同時，地緣政治風險同步升溫。美國聯邦通信委員會 (FCC)7 月 28 日將外國生產的人型、四足先進機器人納入「受控清單」，理由為關鍵基礎設施與資安風險，新款中國製機器人原則上無法取得設備授權，等同禁止進口。
分析人士認為，中國在供應鏈、成本與場景規模的綜合優勢短期難被撼動，但美國市場准入收緊，將迫使陸廠加速轉向歐亞與國內商用工廠落地；監管不確定性與地緣變數，已成為下一階段產業放量的新變量。（
paras_en: According to the latest report from market research firm Smart Analytics Global (SAG), global service robot shipments in the first half of 2023 reached approximately 19,100 units, a nearly 300% increase from the same period last year, with Chinese manufacturers accounting for over 97% of the market share, further expanding their 84.7% lead in 2025.

Data shows that Shanghai-based Agibot shipped 8,400 units in the first half of 2023, accounting for 44% of the global market, surpassing UBTech for the first time, which shipped 5,900 units, accounting for 30.9% of the market share. The two companies combined accounted for over 70% of the market, while Tesla, Figure AI, and Agility Robotics, among other US-based companies, lagged behind in terms of shipments.

SAG founder Linda Sui noted that industrial and commercial applications accounted for over 70% of shipments in the first half of 2023, up from around 50% a year ago, indicating that products are moving from demonstration and research to actual deployment.
SAG also estimates that global service robot shipments will reach 60,000 units this year and break 500,000 units by 2030.
At the recent Shanghai WAIC conference, dozens of Chinese companies showcased their advancements in agility and mobility, underscoring the impact of policy and funding support on production capacity.

However, at the same time, geopolitical risks are escalating. The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) added foreign-produced humanoid and quadruped robots to its 'controlled list' on July 28, citing critical infrastructure and cybersecurity risks. New Chinese-made robots are essentially barred from obtaining equipment authorization, effectively prohibiting imports.

Analysts believe that China's comprehensive advantages in supply chain, cost, and scenario scale will be difficult to shake in the short term, but tightened US market access will force Chinese manufacturers to accelerate their shift towards European, Asian, and domestic commercial factories; regulatory uncertainty and geopolitical variables have become new variables in the next stage of industry expansion.

items.title: 摩根大通上調標普500目標至8000點！AI投資報酬浮現、獲利成長成多頭新引擎
paras: 華爾街長期質疑人工智慧（AI）相關投資是否能真正帶來實質報酬，如今摩根大通 (JPM-US) 給出了較為樂觀的答案，並於本週一（10 日）宣布調高標普 500 指數今年底目標價，因為 AI 投資報酬率逐漸浮現，讓市場對相關企業獲利前景更有信心。
根據《Business Insider》報導，由 Dubravko Lakos-Bujas 領軍的摩根大通策略團隊在報告中，將標普 500 指數年底目標價由原先的 7,800 點上調至 8,000 點。該指數週一收在 7,753.11 點。
策略師指出，隨著投資人終於開始看到數十億美元 AI 資本支出所帶來的投資報酬率，企業獲利也隨之改善。
過去幾個月，科技股表現並不平靜。投資人對於 AI 相關企業的估值是否過高、龐大資本支出能否真正轉化為獲利，抱持疑慮，導致部分重量級科技股走勢反覆承壓。
以追蹤七大科技巨頭的美股七巨頭 ETF(MAGS-US) 為例，股價已從 5 月高點回落約 2%；其中資本支出名列前茅的 Meta(META-US) ，今年以來股價更下跌 7%。
不過摩根大通指出，第二季財報季已顯現轉機。Google(GOOGL-US) 、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與微軟 (MSFT-US) 等雲端業務成長動能增強，訂單積壓擴大，現金流能見度也隨之提升，使這些公司得以跨越市場原本設下的「高門檻」預期。
摩根大通表示：「這顯示，AI 商業化帶來的營收增長速度可能開始快於支出的增加速度，這應有助於推動未來營收更強勁成長，並進一步緩解市場對投資資本報酬率的疑慮。」
AI 資本支出預計仍將持續增加。摩根大通指出，目前市場共識預估，AI 資本支出總額截至今年底將達約 9,000 億美元，較去年增加約 85%；到 2027 年底，這一數字可能進一步升至 1.2 兆美元。
與此同時，企業獲利成長也沒有出現放緩跡象。根據 FactSet 最新資料，在已公布第二季財報的標普 500 成分股中，86% 的企業獲利優於市場預期，76% 的營收也超出預期。
FactSet 上週五（7 日）表示，標普 500 指數目前也有望創下五年來最高的混合獲利成長率。
儘管展望偏多，策略師仍指出市場面臨幾項風險。摩根大通表示，直到 2027 年，多數超大型雲端業者的自由現金流可能持續為負。
此外，該行指出，美國經濟從消費者角度來看仍呈現「K 型分化」，也就是高收入族群與中低收入族群之間的經濟表現差距持續擴大；其中，中低收入美國民眾仍承受累積通膨所帶來的壓力。

items.title: 高盛：投資人不宜離場 三大利多可望支撐美股續航
items.title_en: Goldman: Investors Should Stay Put, Three Bullish Factors to Support US Stocks
paras: 高盛全球銀行與市場部共同主管 Ashok Varadhan 仍建議投資人繼續留在市場。他認為，聯準會今年內不會升息、油價下半年可望回落，加上人工智慧 (AI) 將逐步提升生產力，都是支持風險性資產的三大利多。
儘管利率與油價居高不下，標普 500 指數近期重返歷史高點，今年來累計上漲逾 13%，市場也開始擔心美國經濟能否延續成長，Varadhan 日前在高盛 Podcast 節目《The Markets》中給出「繼續投資美股」的建議。
首先，在貨幣政策方面，Varadhan 預期聯準會今年剩餘時間將維持利率不變，不會重新啟動升息。這項看法較市場預期樂觀，因為通膨仍具黏性，交易員此前一度押注聯準會可能恢復緊縮政策。
不過，美國最新就業報告表現疲弱後，市場已下調近期升息機率。根據芝商所 FedWatch 工具，交易員週一預估聯準會 9 月調整利率的機率降至約 50%，10 月採取行動的機率則約為 63%。
Varadhan 指出，部分推高物價的因素正在減弱，包括關稅對通膨造成的衝擊。如果荷姆茲海峽周邊地緣政治緊張局勢緩和，也可望進一步降低能源與運輸成本，減輕整體物價壓力。
其次，AI 雖然短期可能推升通膨，但長期可望轉化為抑制物價的力量。目前科技業者大舉興建資料中心及 AI 基礎設施，龐大的資本支出對電力、晶片與其他資源形成壓力，短期內可能增加成本；然而，等到相關產能陸續到位後，AI 帶來的生產力提升將有助企業降低營運成本，進而產生通縮效果。
第三項利多來自能源價格。Varadhan 預測，隨著 2026 年進入後半段，原油價格將明顯回落，每桶可望跌至 70 美元以下，甚至可能進一步走低。能源成本下降不僅有助舒緩通膨，也能減輕企業與消費者的負擔。
不過，油市目前仍受到中東局勢牽動。由於市場懷疑美國與伊朗能否達成協議、增加荷姆茲海峽的船舶通行量，西德州中級原油期貨週一重新站上每桶 80 美元。
除了利率、AI 與油價之外，Varadhan 也看好美國經濟的韌性。他表示，即使經歷一連串外部衝擊，美國名目經濟成長仍保持穩健；若地緣政治與通膨等壓力逐步消退，經濟便有機會在 AI 提高生產力的帶動下持續擴張。
經濟基本面穩健也讓 Varadhan 對信用市場維持正面看法。雖然債券發行量龐大，投資人應要求較高的風險補償，但經濟韌性使信用利差未出現大幅擴張。只要外部衝擊逐漸消退，企業實際違約率便可望維持在相對低檔。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs' Global Banking and Markets Co-Head Ashok Varadhan still advises investors to stay in the market, citing three bullish factors: the Federal Reserve will not raise interest rates this year, oil prices are expected to decline in the second half of the year, and artificial intelligence (AI) will gradually boost productivity.

Despite high interest rates and oil prices, the S&P 500 index has recently returned to its historical high, with a year-to-date gain of over 13%. Market participants are starting to worry about the sustainability of US economic growth, and Varadhan recently suggested 'staying invested in US stocks' on Goldman Sachs' podcast 'The Markets'.

Firstly, Varadhan expects the Federal Reserve to maintain interest rates unchanged for the remainder of the year, without restarting rate hikes. This view is more optimistic than market expectations, as inflation remains sticky, and traders had previously bet on a potential return to tightening policy.

However, after the latest US employment report showed weak performance, the market has downgraded the likelihood of rate hikes. According to the Chicago Mercantile Exchange's FedWatch tool, traders on Monday estimated a 50% probability of the Federal Reserve adjusting interest rates in September and a 63% probability in October.

Varadhan notes that some factors driving inflation are weakening, including the impact of tariffs on prices. If tensions in the Strait of Hormuz ease, it could further reduce energy and transportation costs, alleviating overall price pressure.

Secondly, AI may initially drive up inflation, but it is expected to become a force that suppresses prices in the long term. Currently, tech companies are building large data centers and AI infrastructure, which will put pressure on electricity, semiconductors, and other resources, potentially increasing costs in the short term. However, once the relevant capacity comes online, AI will bring productivity gains that will help companies reduce operating costs, leading to a deflationary effect.

The third bullish factor comes from energy prices. Varadhan predicts that, as the second half of 2026 approaches, oil prices will decline significantly, potentially falling below $70 per barrel. Lower energy costs will not only ease inflation but also alleviate the burden on companies and consumers.

However, the oil market is still influenced by the Middle East situation. Due to market concerns about the US and Iran reaching an agreement, increasing shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures rebounded to $80 per barrel on Monday.

In addition to interest rates, AI, and oil prices, Varadhan is also optimistic about the resilience of the US economy. He notes that, despite experiencing a series of external shocks, the US nominal GDP growth has remained stable; if geopolitical tensions and inflation pressures gradually subside, the economy may continue to expand driven by AI-driven productivity gains.

The economy's sound fundamentals also lead Varadhan to maintain a positive view on the credit market. Although bond issuance is massive, investors should demand higher risk compensation, but the economy's resilience has prevented credit spreads from widening significantly. As external shocks gradually subside, corporate actual default rates are expected to remain relatively low.

items.title: SpaceX漲回IPO發行價 散戶上市以來首次淨賣出
items.title_en: SpaceX Rebounds to IPO Price, Retail Investors Sell for First Time
paras: 經過上周一輪大幅回升後，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 周一（10 日）收盤收復 IPO 發行價，但上周五 SpaceX 出現上市後首次散戶淨賣出，高盛警示，市場估值分歧加大，股價可能會延續高波動。
SpaceX 股價周一收漲 4.23% 報 138.74 美元，為 7 月 16 日以來首次收於 IPO 發行價之上，且寫下 7 月 13 日以來最高收盤價。
不過，市場數據分析公司 Vanda Research 的數據顯示，散戶投資者在 8 月 7 日淨賣出價值 450 萬美元的 SpaceX 股票，這是 SpaceX 6 月 12 日上市以來首次出現散戶淨賣出。
業界指出，散戶投資者在 SpaceX 的公開市場交易中扮演關鍵角色：上市過程中，SpaceX 保留了至少 20% 至 30% 的股票供散戶買家認購，遠高於一般 5% 至 10% 的比例。
SpaceX IPO 吸引了散戶群體超過 700 億美元的申購意向請求。
投資平台 eToro 市場分析師 Sam North 表示：「從持續淨買入轉向賣出，很少是單一催化劑，通常是獲利了結、持倉疲勞以及投資者重新評估風險收益比共同作用的結果。上周五的情況尤為有趣，散戶在股價回升至 IPO 價格附近時轉為淨賣家，看起來更像是投資者利用反彈獲利了結，而非恐慌性拋售。」
Vanda 高級股票策略師 Jai Malhi 估計，自 IPO 以來，散戶投資者購買 SpaceX 股票的平均成本為 147 美元，因此，「散戶賣出可能是出於在合適時機減少損失的考量」。
paras_en: After a significant rebound last Monday, SpaceX (SPCX-US) closed on Monday (10th) at the IPO price, but last Friday saw retail investors sell for the first time since listing, with Goldman warning that market valuation disparities have increased, and prices may continue to be volatile.
SpaceX's stock price rose 4.23% on Monday to $138.74, its first close above the IPO price since July 16, and its highest closing price since July 13.

However, data from market data analysis firm Vanda Research showed that retail investors sold a total of $4.5 million worth of SpaceX stock on August 7, the first time retail investors have sold since the company listed on June 12.

Industry insiders point out that retail investors play a crucial role in SpaceX's public market trading: during the listing process, SpaceX reserved at least 20% to 30% of its stock for retail buyers to purchase, far exceeding the usual 5% to 10% ratio.
SpaceX's IPO attracted over $70 billion in retail investor subscription requests.

eToro market analyst Sam North said, "A shift from net buying to selling is rarely a single catalyst; it's usually the result of profit-taking, holding fatigue, and investors reassessing risk-reward ratios. Last Friday's situation was particularly interesting, with retail investors turning into net sellers when the stock price rebounded to the IPO price, which looks more like investors taking profits rather than panic selling."

Vanda's senior equity strategist Jai Malhi estimates that retail investors have purchased SpaceX stock at an average cost of $147 since the IPO, so "retail selling may be a consideration to reduce losses at an opportune time".

items.title_en: Yototech Q3 Revenue Expected to Recover as Satellite Application Heats Up and North America Expansion Deepens
paras: 工業電腦廠攸泰科技 (6928-TW) 上半年受受到客戶專案出貨時程及營收規模影響，每股虧損 0.34 元；不過，隨著衛星應用增溫、北美布局持續深化，第三季營運動能逐步回升。
攸泰上半年營收 9.42 億元，年減 18%；毛利率 28%，較去年同期改善；營業損失 5,118 萬元，稅後淨損 2,942 萬元；不過，7 月營收 1.82 億元，月增 28%、年增 18%；前 7 月營收約 11.24 億元，年減 14%，年減幅度較上半年收斂。
攸泰表示，衛星應用成為 7 月主要成長動能之一，單月營收年增 415%、月增 247%，營收占比提升至近 2 成，主要受政府方案相關專案及衛星通訊產品出貨增加帶動；累計前 7 月衛星應用營收年增 6%，占整體營收比重由去年同期個位數提升至 1 成，顯示相關專案逐步轉化為營收貢獻。
既有核心海事業務 7 月出貨亦較前月回升，單月營收月增 65%；惟受客戶專案時程及去年同期基期較高影響，仍年減 21%。累計前 7 月海事業務營收占比逾五成，仍為公司最大應用市場，公司持續掌握主要客戶專案進度及後續出貨時程，深化既有市場布局。
區域市場方面，主要市場出貨動能回升，其中美洲市場營收月增 30%、年增 7%；歐洲市場月增 68%、年增 93%；亞洲市場亦年增 52%。營收比重來看，美洲營收占比逾四成；歐洲占三成。
累計前 7 月美洲市場營收年增 7%，占整體營收比重由去年同期約三成提升至近四成；亞洲市場年增 43%，營收占比穩健提升；歐洲市場雖受前期專案出貨時程影響年減 26%，但 7 月單月已明顯回升。
新事業布局方面，隨美國子公司營運整合及業務拓展逐步推進，攸泰持續強化北美在地營運與服務能力，並透過集團資源整合擴大產品及應用布局，深化北美市場發展基礎。
攸泰表示，持續聚焦海事、衛星通訊、智慧強固型行動裝置及其他關鍵任務應用市場。隨美國子公司整合持續推進、併購綜效逐步發酵，加上新應用市場拓展及衛星相關專案陸續推進，後續將持續掌握各市場專案進度與出貨動能，同時優化產品組合及營運效率，強化中長期成長動能。
paras_en: Yototech (6928-TW), a leading industrial computer manufacturer, reported a net loss of NT$0.34 per share for the first half of the year due to delayed customer project shipments and revenue scale. However, with the satellite application heating up and North America expansion deepening, the company's third-quarter revenue is expected to recover gradually.

Yototech's first-half revenue reached NT$9.42 billion, a year-on-year decline of 18%. Gross margin improved to 28% compared to the same period last year. The company reported an operating loss of NT$51.18 million and a net loss of NT$29.42 million. However, July revenue reached NT$1.82 billion, a 28% month-on-month increase and an 18% year-on-year increase. The company's revenue for the first seven months of the year was approximately NT$11.24 billion, a year-on-year decline of 14%, with a narrowing year-on-year decline rate compared to the first half.

Yototech stated that satellite applications became a major growth driver in July, with a 415% year-on-year increase and a 247% month-on-month increase in revenue. The revenue share rose to nearly 20%, mainly driven by government project-related projects and satellite communication product shipments. Cumulatively, the company's satellite application revenue grew 6% year-on-year, accounting for 10% of the company's total revenue, up from a single-digit percentage last year, indicating that related projects are gradually converting into revenue contributions.

Both the core marine business and the July shipments also rebounded, with a 65% month-on-month increase in revenue. However, the revenue still declined 21% year-on-year due to customer project timelines and a higher base period last year. Cumulatively, the marine business revenue accounted for over 50% of the company's total revenue, remaining the company's largest application market. The company continues to grasp the progress of major customer projects and subsequent shipment schedules, deepening its existing market layout.

In terms of regional markets, the main market shipment momentum has recovered, with the Americas market revenue increasing 30% month-on-month and 7% year-on-year. The European market revenue increased 68% month-on-month and 93% year-on-year. The Asian market also increased 52% year-on-year. In terms of revenue share, the Americas market accounted for over 40%, while the European market accounted for 30%.

Cumulatively, the Americas market revenue increased 7% year-on-year, accounting for nearly 40% of the company's total revenue, up from around 30% last year. The Asian market revenue increased 43%, with a stable increase in revenue share. The European market, although affected by the delayed project shipment schedule, showed a significant rebound in July.

In terms of new business layout, with the operation integration and business expansion of the US subsidiary gradually advancing, Yototech continues to strengthen its local operations and service capabilities in North America. Through the integration of group resources, the company has expanded its product and application layout, deepening the foundation for North America market development.

Yototech stated that it will continue to focus on the marine, satellite communication, intelligent rugged mobile devices, and other key mission application markets. With the continued advancement of US subsidiary integration, the gradual fermentation of merger synergies, and the expansion of new application markets, as well as the continuous progress of satellite-related projects, the company will continue to grasp the progress of various market projects and shipment momentum, while optimizing product combinations and operational efficiency to strengthen long-term growth momentum.
